items.source: Create a RequestMappingInfo from the supplied @HttpExchange annotation, meta-annotation, or synthesized result of merging annotation attributes within an annotation hierarchy.

items.source: Note: To create the RequestMappingInfo, please use getBuilderConfiguration() and set the options on RequestMappingInfo.Builder.options(RequestMappingInfo.BuilderConfiguration) to match how this HandlerMapping is configured. This is important for example to ensure use of PathPattern or PathMatcher based matching.
items.translation: 注意： 要创建 RequestMappingInfo，请使用 getBuilderConfiguration() 并在 RequestMappingInfo.Builder.options(RequestMappingInfo.BuilderConfiguration) 上设置选项，以匹配此 HandlerMapping 的配置方式。这对于确保使用基于 PathPattern 或 PathMatcher 的匹配非常重要。

items.source: This is useful for programmatic registration of request mappings via registerHandlerMethod(Object, Method, RequestMappingInfo).
items.translation: 这对于通过 `registerHandlerMethod(Object, Method, RequestMappingInfo)` 进行请求映射的程序化注册很有用。

items.source: Uses type-level and method-level @RequestMapping and @HttpExchange annotations to create the RequestMappingInfo.
items.translation: 使用类型级别和方法级别的 @RequestMapping 以及 @HttpExchange 注解来创建 RequestMappingInfo。

items.source: Obtain a RequestMappingInfo.BuilderConfiguration that reflects the internal configuration of this HandlerMapping and can be used to set RequestMappingInfo.Builder.options(RequestMappingInfo.BuilderConfiguration).
items.translation: 获取一个反映此HandlerMapping内部配置的RequestMappingInfo.BuilderConfiguration，该配置可用于设置RequestMappingInfo.Builder.options(RequestMappingInfo.BuilderConfiguration)。

items.source: Determine whether the request matches the given pattern. Use this method when MatchableHandlerMapping.getPatternParser() returns null which means that the HandlerMapping is using String pattern matching.
items.translation: 确定请求是否与给定模式匹配。当MatchableHandlerMapping.getPatternParser()返回null时，使用此方法，这意味着HandlerMapping使用的是字符串模式匹配。
